hook1: [surprised] Wait. I was not expecting my deodorant to be a lotion.
hook2: If your deodorant gives up before lunch, you need to see this.
hook3: Every black top I own had white streaks on it. Until this.
hook4: One hundred hours of sweat and odor protection. In a deodorant.
hook5: Over ten million of these have sold, so I finally tried one.
body: This is Car-pay, and it's clinically tested to control sweat and odor for up to one hundred hours. You twist the bottom, a little lotion comes up, and you rub it in. It goes on clear and dries fast. No chalky stick, no white streaks on my black tee. And Vanilla Peach? [laughs] It smells like peach cobbler. No parabens, no baking soda, no talc, and it's vegan. Grab it from the orange cart before your next sweaty day.
